About FormFit

Why FormFit exists, how it works, and who maintains it.

Why this exists

Every examination season, a large number of candidates get as far as the photograph upload and stop. The form wants an exact pixel size and a file weight inside a narrow band, the error message explains nothing, and the existing tools are either slow, smothered in advertising, or ask you to hand your photograph to an unknown server.

FormFit does one job. You pick your examination, it fills in the correct numbers, and it hands back a file that matches. There is no sign up and no charge.

How it works

All the image processing runs in your browser. When you choose a file, your device reads it, resizes it, and searches for the highest JPEG quality that still lands inside the required kilobyte range. If the result falls below the minimum, it adds JPEG comment padding, which changes the file size without altering a single pixel.

It also reads the orientation tag that phone cameras write, which is why photographs that arrive sideways at other portals come out the right way up here.

Nothing is uploaded. That is a deliberate design decision rather than a limitation, because the safest way to handle somebody's photograph and signature is never to receive it.

Where the sizes come from

The presets are compiled from published examination notifications. We check them against official documents, but requirements change and mistakes are possible, so every page tells you to verify against your own notice. If you find a number that is wrong, please tell us and we will correct it.

How it is funded

The site carries advertising, which covers hosting and the time spent keeping the presets current. There is no paid tier and no feature held back behind one.
